verdict.rationale: Collecting feedback from a website is a fair question for a product-feedback platform like Productboard, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions an embeddable feedback widget or a script-tag install. The REST API for creating feedback (productboard-docs-27) is a developer building block for building such intake yourself, not the widget itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed a feedback widget on my website with a single script tag and no build step
